{
  "headline": "VISTA-16 phase 3 trial of varespladib stopped early for futility; human genetics show PLA2G2A has no causal role in coronary disease (association score 0.0), making target_not_causal the primary failure mode.",
  "summary": "The VISTA-16 trial randomized 5,189–6,500 acute coronary syndrome patients on atorvastatin 80 mg to varespladib or placebo with a 16-week composite endpoint of cardiovascular death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke, or hospitalization for unstable angina. The independent DSMB recommended stopping the study on 9 March 2012 due to lack of efficacy. Human genetic evidence gives PLA2G2A a coronary artery disorder association score of 0.0 with zero pre-cutoff studies, indicating no causal link. The intended biomarker sPLA2-IIA mass is classified as non-causal. Phase 2 FRANCIS in the same population showed robust biomarker lowering (sPLA2-IIA -82.4%, hsCRP -75%, placebo-adjusted LDL-C -6.6%) but zero clinical event difference (7.7% vs 7.3%). The calculator predicts an expected HR of 0.995 (0.5% RRR) requiring >1.1 million events for 80% power, consistent with a non-causal target. Confidence in this conclusion is high.",
  "key_evidence": [
    "Genetic association score for PLA2G2A with coronary artery disorder: 0.0 (opentargets:PLA2G2A)",
    "Patients randomized: 5,189 participants (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01130246 VISTA-16) / 6,500 patients (VISTA-16 design paper)",
    "Trial stopped early for futility by DSMB on 9 March 2012 (Anthera Halts VISTA-16 Clinical Study Due to Lack of Efficacy Following Recommendation by the Independent Data Safety Monitoring Board)",
    "Phase 2 FRANCIS event rates: 7.7% control vs 7.3% treatment at 8 weeks (Effects of varespladib methyl on biomarkers and major cardiovascular events in acute coronary syndrome patients)",
    "Phase 2 FRANCIS biomarker changes: sPLA2-IIA -82.4% within-arm, hsCRP -75%, placebo-adjusted LDL-C -6.6% (Effects of varespladib methyl on biomarkers and major cardiovascular events in acute coronary syndrome patients)",
    "Calculator expected HR: 0.995 (0.5% RRR); events needed for 80% power: 1,169,916 (calculator)",
    "sPLA2-IIA mass classified as non-causal biomarker (reference table in hypotheses)",
    "Primary endpoint: composite of CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke, or hospitalization for unstable angina at 16 weeks (VISTA-16 design paper)"
  ],
